topic: what the browser padlock does and does not mean
angle: The padlock proves the connection is encrypted, not that the site is honest.

claims.text: In Google research from 2021 only 11 percent of study participants correctly understood the precise meaning of the lock icon.
Nearly all phishing sites use HTTPS and therefore also display the lock icon.
Chrome replaced the lock icon with a neutral "tune" icon (announced May 2023, shipped from Chrome 117).
The lock icon only shows that the connection is secure; it does not show that the site is trustworthy.
